Tools/Crafting Calculator/Splendent Ruby Necklace

Splendent Ruby Necklace — Crafting Recipe & Materials

Everything you need to craft Splendent Ruby Necklace in AION 2: the direct recipe, the full base-material shopping list summed across every sub-craft, and where to get each material.

Grade: RareProfession: JewelcraftingMastery level: 10

Splendent / combo craft: Splendent Ruby Necklace is not crafted directly — it procs with a 25% chance each time you craft Ruby Necklace. The material lists below are per successful base craft.

Splendent Ruby Necklace recipe — direct components

  • Ruby Decoration×1
  • Refining Stone×4
  • Odyle×1

All base materials for Splendent Ruby Necklace

Every sub-recipe expanded — this is the complete shopping list of raw materials to gather, farm or buy (2 total crafts).

  • Abrasive (Bound)×10
  • Refining Stone×4
  • Ruby Gemstone×20
  • Odyle×1

Intermediate crafts you'll make along the way

  • Splendent Ruby Necklace×1
  • Ruby Decoration×1
